newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey's anti-Islamists clinch confidence vote.
newsitem.headline: Turkey's anti-Islamists clinch confidence vote.

text.p: Turkish Prime Minister Mesut Yilmaz's anti-Islamist government won a confidence vote in parliament on Saturday by a vote of 280 to 256, according to unofficial results.
Two deputies abstained and about a dozen skipped the vote in the 550-seat legislature, in which Yilmaz and his allies needed a simple majority.
The vote confirmed a return to power for Turkey's secularists, after one year and one day under the modern republic's first Islamist government.
